Author: anungis437
Message:
feat: Union Eyes ML Pack v1 (Supervised)

* feat(db/ml): add mlScoresUECasesPriority and mlScoresUESlaRisk tables (PR1)

- Table G: ml_scores_ue_cases_priority
  - caseId (uuid, no FK - keeps ML schema decoupled from UE verticals)
  - score/predictedPriority/actualPriority, featuresJson, modelId, inferenceRunId
  - unique on (entityId, caseId, modelId); indexes on predictedPriority + occurredAt

- Table H: ml_scores_ue_sla_risk
  - probability/predictedBreach/actualBreach, featuresJson, modelId, inferenceRunId
  - unique on (entityId, caseId, modelId); indexes on predictedBreach + occurredAt

* feat(tooling/ml): UE supervised dataset builder (PR2)

- lib/ueFeatureEngineering.ts: pure TS feature engineering
  - buildUECaseFeatures(), toCsv(), UE_CASE_SCHEMA_JSON
  - 14 feature columns including dayOfWeek, hourOfDay, ageHoursAtSnapshot
  - Deterministic train/val/test split via djb2Hash(caseId) % 10

- build-ue-case-supervised-dataset.ts: CLI dataset builder
  - Queries ue_cases via raw SQL (db.execute); no Drizzle schema for UE verticals
  - Writes ue_case_priority_dataset_v1 + ue_case_sla_dataset_v1 to Blob
  - Registers mlDatasets rows + emits ml.dataset_built audit events

* feat(tooling/ml): train ue.case_priority_v1 multiclass classifier (PR3)

- lib/db_write.py: upsert_ue_priority_score(), upsert_ue_sla_risk_score()
- lib/metrics.py: build_supervised_multiclass_metrics(), build_supervised_binary_metrics()

- train_ue_case_priority.py:
  - GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, lr=0.1, subsample=0.8)
  - OrdinalEncoder on categoricals, LabelEncoder on y
  - Metrics: accuracy, macro_f1, confusion matrix, per-class P/R/F1, calibration
  - Full audit trail: ml.training_started/completed + ml.model_registered
  - Artifact + metrics JSON uploaded to Blob, sha256 fingerprinted

* feat(tooling/ml): train ue.sla_breach_risk_v1 binary classifier (PR4)

- GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=3, lr=0.05, subsample=0.8)
- choose_threshold_by_recall(): finds lowest threshold achieving recall >= 0.80
  (falls back to F1-max if target recall unachievable); rationale stored in metrics.json
- Metrics: ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision/recall/F1 at chosen threshold, confusion matrix
- --target-recall CLI flag (default 0.80)
- Same audit + Blob artifact pattern as priority model

* feat(tooling/ml): inference script for ue.case_priority_v1 (PR5)

- Auto-resolves active model if --model-id not provided
- Queries ue_cases via psycopg2 over --period-start/--period-end window
- predict_proba + argmax -> predictedPriority; upserts to ml_scores_ue_cases_priority
- Uploads scored.csv artifact to Blob; emits ml.inference_completed audit event

* feat(tooling/ml): inference script for ue.sla_breach_risk_v1 (PR6)

- Loads stored decision threshold from model artifact (supports --threshold-override)
- predict_proba[:, 1] -> probability; applies threshold -> predictedBreach bool
- Upserts to ml_scores_ue_sla_risk; uploads scored.csv to Blob

* feat(ml-sdk,console): ML Signals API + SDK for UE supervised models (PR7)

packages/ml-core/src/types.ts:
  - ML_MODEL_KEYS: UE_CASE_PRIORITY_V1, UE_SLA_BREACH_RISK_V1
  - ML_DATASET_KEYS: UE_CASE_PRIORITY_DATASET_V1, UE_CASE_SLA_DATASET_V1
  - Interfaces: MlScoreUECasePriority, MlScoreUESlaRisk, UEPriorityClass

packages/ml-sdk/src/types.ts + client.ts:
  - getUEPriorityScores() -> GET /api/ml/scores/ue/cases/priority
  - getUESlaRiskScores()  -> GET /api/ml/scores/ue/cases/sla-risk
  - Response: { items, nextCursor, total }

apps/console/app/api/ml/scores/ue/cases/priority/route.ts:
  - Keyset pagination (lt occurredAt cursor), priorityFilter, includeFeatures guard
apps/console/app/api/ml/scores/ue/cases/sla-risk/route.ts:
  - breachFilter, minProb post-query filter, same pagination pattern
  - Both: RBAC via requireEntityAccess(); includeFeatures requires entity_admin

* feat(apps/union-eyes): UE app UI with ML signals integration (PR8)

New app: apps/union-eyes (port 3003)
  - Depends on @nzila/ml-sdk only — no direct @nzila/db imports

lib/useUEMlSignals.ts:
  - useCasePrioritySignal(entityId, caseId, getToken) -> latest priority score
  - useCaseSlaRiskSignal(entityId, caseId, getToken)  -> latest SLA risk score
  - useCaseListSignals(entityId, start, end, getToken) -> Map<caseId, score> x2

components/ml/PriorityBadge.tsx:
  - Colour-coded badge: critical=red, high=orange, medium=yellow, low=green
  - showConfidence prop; null/loading fallbacks

components/ml/SlaRiskBadge.tsx:
  - Tier mapping: prob>0.60=High(red), 0.30-0.60=Medium(amber), <0.30=Low(emerald)

components/ml/CaseSignalsPanel.tsx:
  - Sidebar panel with priority + SLA signals, model key, run ID, last-updated ts

app/cases/page.tsx:
  - Case list table with ML Priority + SLA Risk columns; skeleton loading; search

app/cases/[caseId]/page.tsx:
  - Two-column layout: case detail + CaseSignalsPanel sidebar

* feat(ml-core/evidence): add UE ML summaries to evidence pack appendix (PR9)

packages/ml-core/src/evidence/collector.ts:
  - Imports mlScoresUECasesPriority, mlScoresUESlaRisk from @nzila/db/schema
  - New interfaces: UEPriorityClassCount, UEPrioritySummary, UESlaSummary
  - MlEvidenceAppendix.uePrioritySummary: { totalScored, byClass[4] } | null
  - MlEvidenceAppendix.ueSlaSummary: { totalScored, predictedBreachCount } | null
  - collectMlEvidence(): 7 parallel count queries for UE priority distribution
    + SLA breach count; null when no scores exist in period
  - UE datasets + active models auto-included via existing entity-scoped queries

* fix(console): add @nzila/db subpath TypeScript path mappings

moduleResolution: 'bundler' was not reliably resolving @nzila/db/schema
through the pnpm workspace symlink at compile time, causing TS2305 errors
on all ML score routes (Stripe + UE).

Explicit paths mirror the @nzila/ui pattern already present:
  @nzila/db        -> packages/db/src/index.ts
  @nzila/db/schema -> packages/db/src/schema/index.ts
  @nzila/db/client -> packages/db/src/client.ts

Reduces clean-build TS errors in console from 65 -> 52 (13 ML route
errors eliminated; remaining 52 are pre-existing schema name mismatches
unrelated to this change).

* fix(ml-sdk): export UE types from barrel + remove unsafe param casts

types-internal.ts:
  - Add UEPriorityClass to re-export from @nzila/ml-core types

index.ts:
  - Add UEPriorityScoreResponse, UESlaRiskScoreResponse,
    UEPriorityScoresParams, UESlaRiskScoresParams to barrel export

client.ts:
  - Replace 'params as Record<string, ...>' casts with '{ ...params }'
    spread, which satisfies the index signature constraint without
    unsafe type assertions (fixes TS2352 on all four get() call sites)

* feat(apps/union-eyes): add app scaffold + fix searchParams type (fixup PR8)

Scaffold files missing from PR8:
  - tsconfig.json: extends tsconfig.nextjs.json; @/* alias + explicit
    @nzila/ml-sdk/* path mappings so TS resolves workspace pkg source
  - next.config.ts: standalone output, transpilePackages for ml-sdk/ml-core/ui
  - next-env.d.ts, postcss.config.mjs, eslint.config.mjs

page.tsx fix:
  - Cast Promise.resolve({}) to { entityId?: string } so sp.entityId
    resolves correctly without TS2339 (property does not exist on {})

Author: Aubert Nungisa
Message:
feat(migration): complete UE & ABR data/auth migration phases

- Data migration: 364 tables, 6,981 rows (100% validated)
  - UE: 265/265 tables from Azure PostgreSQL -> nzila_union_eyes
  - ABR: 99/99 tables from Supabase -> nzila_abr_insights
- Model migration: UUID PKs, BaseModel inheritance on all models
  - UE: 512 models across 11 apps, 524 tables created
  - ABR: 116 models across 8 apps, 127 tables created
- Auth migration: Clerk JWT backend installed on both backends
  - Production auth: authentication.py, middleware.py, views.py, urls.py
  - UE & ABR .env configured with live Clerk credentials
  - Webhook handlers, /me/, /health/ endpoints added
- Data migration engine: data_migrator.py (~1120 lines)
  - FK topological sort, batch inserts, resume/checkpoint support
  - ARRAY vs JSONB handling, reserved word column renaming
  - Dry-run + validation modes
- Code generator improvements: BaseModel default, UUID PK template,
  reserved word sanitization, index name truncation
- Scaffold: UE and ABR django project structure populated
- TypeScript API clients generated from frontend service analysis
- Django API views generated for business logic layer
- Azure resource inventory captured (25 RGs, consolidation plan)
- Migration dashboard updated to 72% overall progress

Message:
feat(migration): complete UE & ABR data/auth migration phases

- Data migration: 364 tables, 6,981 rows (100% validated)
  - UE: 265/265 tables from Azure PostgreSQL -> nzila_union_eyes
  - ABR: 99/99 tables from Supabase -> nzila_abr_insights
- Model migration: UUID PKs, BaseModel inheritance on all models
  - UE: 512 models across 11 apps, 524 tables created
  - ABR: 116 models across 8 apps, 127 tables created
- Auth migration: Clerk JWT backend installed on both backends
  - Production auth: authentication.py, middleware.py, views.py, urls.py
  - UE & ABR .env configured with live Clerk credentials
  - Webhook handlers, /me/, /health/ endpoints added
- Data migration engine: data_migrator.py (~1120 lines)
  - FK topological sort, batch inserts, resume/checkpoint support
  - ARRAY vs JSONB handling, reserved word column renaming
  - Dry-run + validation modes
- Code generator improvements: BaseModel default, UUID PK template,
  reserved word sanitization, index name truncation
- Scaffold: UE and ABR django project structure populated
- TypeScript API clients generated from frontend service analysis
- Django API views generated for business logic layer
- Azure resource inventory captured (25 RGs, consolidation plan)
- Migration dashboard updated to 72% overall progress
